metadata.title: AI Infrastructure Atlas

coverage.description: Expandable public-source sample across equipment, logic, memory, packaging, compute and power. No global market-share, output or power totals.
unknowns: Fab yields, utilization and qualified wafer starts
Site-level GPU allocation for multisite deployments
Current energized power versus planned campus capacity
Customer shares and confidential supply contracts
rules: Null means not established by this evidence set, never zero.
A company supplying a customer does not establish which fab supplied that customer.
Links describe disclosed relationships, not provenance of a particular deployed chip.
All map coordinates are approximate editorial locality markers, never claimed facility coordinates.
No capacity or spending totals: measurements differ, periods overlap and shared assets would double-count.
Company announcements verify what was announced; they do not independently verify delivery or performance.
Last-reported status and source date must remain visible. A past target date does not prove operation.
Separate power contracts, generation, facility power, IT load, GPU counts and wafer output.
Separate construction, commissioning, qualification, volume production and mature utilization.
Process-node names are vendor labels, not directly comparable physical dimensions.
